column6: eval (() => { const heads = [...document.querySelectorAll('h2, h3, h4')]; const m = heads.filter(h => /404/.test(h.textContent) && /Not Found/.test(h.textContent)); return m.map(h => h.id + ' | ' + h.textContent.trim()).join('\n') })()
eval (() => { const h = document.getElementById('name-404-not-found'); const sec = h.closest('section') || h.parentElement; return sec.textContent.slice(0, 400) })()
